mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (m/m), or Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS show m/m growth, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% month-over-month during expansionary regimes indicates rising supply capacity, supporting corporate profitability and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% (m/m), or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month non-farm payrolls increase above 0.3% signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.3% (m/m), or Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS show m/m decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0% month-over-month during contractionary regimes indicates declining supply capacity, lowering corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth is negative, or Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.
